ClinicFlow V2: every module, core or add-on

Long image

A

Answer

ClinicFlow V2 is one platform with 16 clinic modules: 8 core modules that every clinic gets, and 8 add-ons that each clinic switches on through its plan.

  1. The core runs a booking clinic: the clinic and its staff, patient sign-up, services and prices, scheduling, appointments, notifications and audit.1
  2. The add-ons deepen it: front desk, billing, clinical records, insurance, reports, patient portal, recruitment and the chatbot.2
  3. One build serves every clinic. A platform module turns add-ons, limits and message quotas on per clinic.2
  4. Modules arrive in phases. The foundation (P0) is done, and the core is complete after P2.3

Applies toWhole V2 as planned in docs/v2 (commit 88771d2). The core/add-on split is ADR 0008, still Proposed.

  1. Organization ↗

    Set up the clinic: branches, rooms, working hours and holidays.

  2. Staff & access ↗

    Invite staff and give each a role per branch. Recruitment feeds hired doctors in.

  3. Scheduling ↗

    Turn doctor shifts into bookable slots inside branch hours.

  4. Appointments ↗

    The hub: every booking, from any channel, follows one state machine.

  5. Notifications ↗

    Each appointment event sends in-app, email and WhatsApp messages.

  6. Billing & payments ↗

    An add-on: turns each visit into an invoice and takes payment at the desk.

Arrows show what one module hands to the next. Each module tag gives its code and the phase that builds it.

2

What does each core module do?

Core moduleWhat it doesPhase
Organization (ORG)The clinic and its branches: addresses, time zones, working hours, holidays, rooms and settings such as the cancellation window.P1
Staff & access (STF)Staff join by invitation, get roles per branch and must use MFA. Access follows permissions, not role names.P1
Accounts & sign-in (ACC)Patients sign up with an Egyptian mobile number and a one-time code by WhatsApp. Login works with phone or email.P1
Services & prices (SVC)The service catalog and price list, priced per branch or per doctor. Patients see the price before booking.P1
Scheduling (SCH)Doctor shifts per branch and room, leave, blocked slots and a rolling window of slots.P2
Appointments (APT)One state machine for every booking: book, reschedule, cancel, check in, no-show and complete.P0–P2
Notifications (NTF)In-app, email and phone messages from Arabic and English templates. Patients choose phone, email or both.P1–P2
Audit (AUD)Records who changed what, when and from where on every sensitive record. Entries can never be edited.P0–P4

The admin dashboard, with KPI tiles and up to four charts, also belongs to the core. Only the reports beyond it are an add-on.4

3

What does each add-on do, and who needs it?

Add-onWhat it addsWho needs itNeedsPhase
Front desk & queue (FD)Desk booking, walk-ins, check-in, a live queue board and a waiting-room screen.Clinics with a reception deskAPTP2
Billing & payments (BIL)Invoices from visits, cash and card at the desk, cash sessions, refunds and optional Paymob deposits.Clinics that bill every visitAPT, SVCP3
Clinical records (EMR)Encounters with vitals, notes, ICD-10 diagnoses, prescriptions and orders, signed and locked.Doctors who document in the systemAPTP4
Insurance (INS)Payers, plans, policies, the co-pay split, pre-authorizations, claims and denials.Clinics that bill insurersBIL, EMRP5
Reports (RPT)Doctor usage, no-show, revenue, claims and clinical-quality reports, with exports.Managers of larger clinicsOther modules' dataP2–P6
Patient portal (PAT)Online booking with prices, deposits, invoices, visit summaries and uploads.Clinics that take online bookingsAPTP2–P6
Recruitment (REC)Doctors apply with a CV and move through Applied → Interview → Accepted, with an email at each stage.Clinics that hire doctors oftenSTFP1
Chatbot (BOT)An Arabic and English assistant in the portal that answers clinic questions and finds slots.Clinics with many online patientsPATP7

Enabling an add-on also enables what it needs. Insurance, for example, switches billing on.2

4

What holds every module together?

PieceWhat it guaranteesStatus
TenancyEvery clinic-owned row carries OrganizationId, and every query is filtered by it. One clinic never sees another's data.DoneBuilt in P0
PermissionsEach endpoint needs a permission, and the service checks the record's scope: own, branch or organization.DoneBuilt in P0
OutboxEvents are saved with the change and delivered about 2 s later, with retries. Modules react without calling each other.DoneBuilt in P0
Audit trailA save hook writes the audit entries in the same transaction as the change.DoneBuilt in P0
One clockTimes are stored in UTC. Slots keep the branch's local time next to the exact instant.DoneBuilt in P0
Phone channelsWhatsApp and SMS are switches. WhatsApp goes first; SMS is built but off.Planned for P1
EntitlementsEach clinic's plan turns add-ons, limits and message quotas on.ADR 0008Proposed

WhatsApp is not free: Meta charges about $0.0036 per template message in Egypt.5

Billing comes before clinical records on purpose: taking money at the desk is part of every visit, while records need legal sign-off first.6

Any plan can add extra WhatsApp messages, SMS, extra doctors or branches, recruitment, Paymob deposits and the chatbot.4

Still to decide

The tiers and numbers are examples to test the model, not prices (Q19). ADR 0008 is still Proposed, and the platform phase has no place in the order yet (Q20). The WhatsApp provider, Meta directly or a reseller, is open (Q2). The chatbot's scope is decided in P7 (Q16).

7

What is deliberately left out?

Left out of V2Why
Inventory and equipmentExcluded by the business
Lab, radiology and pharmacy systemsV2 writes orders and prescriptions and stores results; it doesn't run a lab or a pharmacy
HR and payrollHiring doctors is the only HR process in scope
Telemedicine and native mobile appsSeparate product decisions; the web app stays responsive
Electronic links to insurers and the e-receipt systemClaims are exported and tracked by hand for now

These come from the scope document's out-of-scope list.7
